Confirm the repository and required capability: $repository_scope
Request and verify it through $repository_grant_route.

Use your intended account to perform a permitted operation that proves
the required capability. Reading does not prove write or merge authority;
a request does not prove access. Do not push a test change or grant broad
permissions without approval. Configure separate section instances for
repositories with independent outcomes. Report wrong-account access or
excessive permissions to the grantor.
